nextSteps.STREET_SURVEY: The 1934-38 rows on the south side (Haarlemmerweg 507-651, and the Gibraltarstraat / Van Gentstraat / Kijkduinstraat / Livornostraat / Solebaystraat corners) and the 1988 row at 477-495 are repetitive frontages: one rhythm per block face, shared facade recipe (street-survey / block-face pipeline), not one large recipe per address. Those blocks carry the shopfronts the user photographed (Stichting De Gibraltar, Amsterdam Skin care, Taco Lindo West, Dojo Doorje).
nextSteps.TRACK_L: No pand in this window is a pre-1900 ornamented historic front, so this corridor produced no TRACK_L row. If the 1934 decorative brick fronts at 507-519 are judged too ornamented for the block-face survey they are the only Track L candidates here, and need a Track L lane with its own inventory and elevations.
nextSteps.NO_EVIDENCE: Molenwerf 1 and Molenwerf 2 (the 1980/2003 office campus behind the north-side frontage: Kennedy Van der Laan, WJ Digital Marketing, MB limousines, Gymbase Westerpark in the user screenshot) have no panorama reaching a corridor-facing wall (29-38 m back behind their forecourt), and Haarlemmerweg 518A has only a 2022 construction crop. Haarlemmerweg 1140A is a 2024 cycle shed. They stay unbuilt until a newer capture or a survey route exists.
nextSteps.TRACK_M_REMAINING: Molenwerf 1 stays TRACK_M but unbuilt (no corridor panorama); 518A needs a post-2023 capture of its Haarlemmerweg front before it can be measured.
